spans.text_exact: “He is right about the moral meaning.”
“And we're supposed to care about her love story with Nara?”
spans.speaker: imani

spans.text_exact: “The hidden fragments make her sound like resistance.”
“Or wanted the third witness to know.”
spans.speaker: imani

spans.text_exact: “She saved one after killing how many?”
“Maybe: I learned the criterion was invalid. 'Sacred' is our word.”
“She built institutional memory against institutional lying.”
spans.speaker: cassian

spans.text_exact: “That's what archives are supposed to do.”

“Sexagesimal mathematics does not need aliens. Repetition in ritual does not need aliens. Flood stories do not need aliens. Her strategy, if the archive is accurate, was to hide corrective information inside things humans already preserved because they worked for human reasons.”
“Do not make every tradition a cipher.”
“That's why the archive wants a third observer.”
“Not to receive revelation. To adjudicate disagreement.”
“We're not letting a machine become supreme court of deep history because an alien dissident designed a checksum.”
“we do not call her a hero.”
spans.speaker: imani

spans.text_exact: “Because leaving is easier when your institution is only wrong.”
spans.speaker: imani

spans.text_exact: “Nara taught me some questions deserve bad data.”
“Someone who taught me not to confuse preservation with ownership.”
spans.speaker: seren

spans.text_exact: “Did anyone argue the intervention itself caused the migration failure?”
“We could not distinguish intervention effect from preexisting instability.”
“Conflict probability. Technological acceleration. migration variance. Noncompliance.”
spans.speaker: nico

spans.text_exact: “I did not learn that life was sacred.”
spans.speaker: seren

spans.text_exact: “I learned that my measure of useful life was false.”
“If three disagree, a future witness can recover the difference.”
“Probability of uncontrolled divergence beyond intervention capacity.”
“Accuracy to the wrong question is still wrong.”
spans.speaker: cassian

spans.text_exact: “Because this is evidence about your actions.”
“In the way you have reconstructed its weight.”
“So you penalized the exact property that would later make populations survive resets.”
“That is how civilizations lie without believing they are lying.”
